jobs.description:
DHL Aviation, DHL Express’s sorting center in Belgium, is the beating heart of package transport at the airport.The brand-new building is a showcase of automation and technology in the field of logistics. Shipments are delivered by truck or plane from all over the world, consolidated at Brucargo, and sorted for their final destinations. These shipments are then loaded onto trucks or planes again and transported to their final destinations.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for DHL Aviation, you are trained to perform following tasks: loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing shipments by trucks and plains throughout the world. DHL has an excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience: enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important.

• Your knowledge of English is very good (important for all work and safety related instructions on the job).
•  You have a basic knowledge of Dutch (level A1, your level will be put to the test).
• You can work full-time, 38hours a week.
• You can work from Monday through Friday on a weekly base in the shifts 7PM-3AM and 8PM-4AM.
• You are willing to improve your knowledge of Dutch (DHL offers Dutch learning sessions during the working hours).
• DHL Aviation is located on the following address: Vliegveld 117, 1820 Steenokkerzeel.
• You are able to get to work on your behalf
• You are looking forward to having an energetic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy shipments ( /- 25 kg on a regular basis)
• Working safely comes first for you.
• You can work in accordance with internal quality processes and procedures, as well as legal requirements.

Our team is responsible for performing the final quality checks on Honda motorcycles. Every employee receives comprehensive internal training to prepare them for the role.Your tasks will include: 

 
• Connecting motorcycle batteries 
 
• Checking and refilling engine oil

Who are we looking for? 

 
• Experience in assembly or production 
 
• A background in construction or technical work 
 
• Recent graduates from technical programs 
 
• Anyone with technical affinity and the motivation to learn 
 
• Work schedule: 2 shifts (06:00–14:00 & 14:00–22:00) 
 
• English communication skills are required.

📦 Warehouse Worker in 2 Shifts Wanted – Do you enjoy active work in a dynamic environment?

Your tasks:

You will build your own market, develop new business, headhunt top IT talent and manage the recruitment process from A to Z.The Role

Who are you?

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver | Full-Time | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
As a CE Truck Driver, you start your day from the company's site in Horebeke with a refrigerated truck loaded with fresh potato products. You'll follow a planned route and deliver goods to distribution centres, wholesalers and retail customers, making for an average of about 8 stops per day. As a CE Truck Driver, you are responsible for checking delivery documents, ensuring accurate deliveries and handling products with care. Loading and unloading is mainly done using an electric pallet truck, limiting heavy physical work. There’s occasional work on Saturdays, between 8 AM. and 5 PM, in which case you get a day off during the week. You work independently, take pride in maintaining your vehicle and follow a schedule that is communicated in advance.

 
We are looking for a CE Truck Driver who combines professionalism with a customer-oriented mindset. The ideal CE Truck Driver has:

 
• A valid CE driving license with a valid code 95 certification.
 
• Previous experience as a CE driver.
 
• Good communication skills in English, additional language skills are considered a plus.
 
• A responsible and independent attitude.
 
• A customer-friendly and professional approach.
 
• Flexibility regarding working hours when needed.
 
• Respect for safety procedures and company equipment.

This internationaly active production company is looking for a highly self-motivated, results oriented and solutions driven Management Trainee with a general interest in all levels of a business and a general interest in developing new technologies. After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.

• 2 years of previous work experiences.
• A fluent pen and verbal skills in English and Dutch. Any additional languages would be great.

Our client, based in Mechelen, is an international leader in medical imaging. You will join a modern and people-oriented working environment where quality, collaboration, and personal development are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

Would you like to work for an international company where technology and healthcare come together?

As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.

• Provide technical support to customers regarding software, hardware, and connectivity issues.
• Assist customers via phone, email, and remote support, primarily in French.
• Analyse technical issues and work together with customers to find the most suitable solution.
• Guide customers through software installations, updates, and configurations.
• Accurately register and follow up on support requests in the CRM system.
• Escalate more complex issues to specialised colleagues when necessary.
• Work closely with colleagues and other internal departments to resolve complex technical queries.

Who are we looking for?

• You have initial experience in Technical Support, Customer Support, or an IT Help Desk role.
• You have a strong interest in software, IT, and technology.
• You are fluent in both French and English, both spoken and written, as you will use these languages daily when communicating with customers and colleagues.
• You are solution-oriented and remain organised when dealing with multiple requests at the same time.
• You are able to prioritise effectively and manage your workload efficiently.
• A secondary education diploma (A2 level) is sufficient. Above all, we value your motivation, eagerness to learn, and passion for technology.

Where Italian nostalgia meets real hospitality leadership
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example during service, keeps the room running like clockwork, and makes sure every guest leaves feeling like they just had dinner at home.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Welcome guests and set the tone for the evening 

• Take orders and serve with precision, even when it's slammed 

• Own the floor during service — pace, table turns, team energy, guest happiness 

• Coach and steady the team in real time; step in and solve problems before guests notice them 

• Be the calm, capable presence management can count on when it gets busy  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A natural feel for service and a bit of leadership instinct 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, solutions over excuses 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €16.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real responsibility on the floor from day one — with a clear path to become manager within your first 6 to 12 months 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.
